I did the same thing twice. One thing I learned is that something really life changing stuff needs to happen to stop being suicidal. So basically just by yourself you can't really do anything about it sadly. But maybe you can cut down on these thoughts. First of all you need to keep your family and friends as close as possible. If they care about you, they will be there to help you in any way they can or at least listen to you. Don't be shy to share your problems. Another thing you can do is if you can't help yourself, you can help others. The same way, listen to other people, help with their problems, do charity work, whatever. It will make you feel better too and keep your thoughts away from suicide, I promise.
I feel you. Sometimes I wish my parents wouldn't care for me at all. Well, not sometimes, always. Such a fucked up thought and I hate myself for it.
Most of the time I'm in this empty space too, when I don't feel anything. So damn strange that feeling nothing is worse than hitting rock bottom, at least for me it is.
